title: the next round: a playtest, the owner's feedback, then the story's timing re-worked over its whole arc
context: Owner, 2026-11-08, closing the session after THE LANDING's three looks (merged on overnight-2026-10-23 at 7a737a81, 8c2ed58d, 39f98d63) and THE SETTLING (branch the-settling, spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-08-the-settling-design.md, built by four tasks, its browser run and merge the session's last step): "sync then we will close everything down, and next time I need to 1) playtest 2) give feedback and 3) we need to re-work the timing of the story; land, build, discover, combat, choices, hectic waves, last cave mission and connecting to the dyson sphere." The arc he names is the game's whole spine, each stage of which exists today under its own name: LAND is the arrival and the flown landing (src/fx/arrival.js, src/fx/manual-landing.js); BUILD is Isao's programme from the deploy and, since the settling, the first orders out of the rocket's salvage with the Stålheart non-negotiable (src/content/base-programme.js, src/fx/first-orders.js); DISCOVER is the study, the expedition's landing sites and the rover (src/domain/story-beats.js study/expedition, src/fx/rover-glue.js); COMBAT is the sector loop and its tutorial seats (src/fx/sector-run.js, the Rotor and the Quiver); CHOICES is THE BUILD BOARD between sectors (src/fx/build-board.js); HECTIC WAVES are the sector shapes, THE PRESS and the canyon (src/content/sectors.js); the LAST CAVE MISSION is THE DESCENT after BOTH WALLS (src/fx/descent-host.js, below/); CONNECTING TO THE DYSON SPHERE is THE ENDING's finale (src/fx/ending-host.js, STORY_MISSION's LINK THE SPHERE). Their timing was set one round at a time (STORY_BEATS, STORY_SETTLE, STORY_CONSTRUCTION, the sector table, SECTOR_HOLD, BOTH_WALLS_SECTOR, the door at 7 or 8) and has never been laid out and tuned as one line; the director board (src/domain/director-board.js, labs.html#director) draws it.
outcome: DIRECTION, nothing built: the next round opens with the owner's headed playtest of the merged build (the flown landing with the exhaust signature and the side view, the settling's first orders and 120 s clock, the sector loop) and his notes; the re-work of the story's timing follows his feedback and is designed before it is built: the whole arc on one timeline (the director board is the instrument), each stage with a target duration and what fills it, the hand-overs between stages, and where the player's choices fall. Open from the settling for that design: the settle's 120 s against the Stålheart's 75 s print (sector 0's NUKE THE ENTRANCE no longer plays on the default opening because the Stålheart stands at ~95 s), the first orders only once, the enemies on a timer rather than on the scouting. The owner reads the branch reports in .superpowers/sdd/ of the worktrees before they are removed. Nothing is pushed: overnight-2026-10-23 is some 75 commits ahead of origin and goes out only on his word.
alternatives: Re-working the timing now, before the playtest: rejected by the owner's order of work (playtest, feedback, then the re-work); the settling already moved the opening's first contact by two minutes unseen.
Treating each stage's clock as its own round, as until now: rejected by the owner's framing (one arc from the landing to the sphere), which is what the re-work is for.
evidence: The director board's timeline: node test/director-board.mjs; labs.html#director
The owner's words of 2026-11-08 quoted in context; no measurement: a direction, not a result
